## What Is a Perry Homes Internship?


The Perry Homes internship is a structured summer program where students work full-time (40 hours per week) across residential homebuilding departments including active construction sites, headquarters operations, and field offices. Vault ranked Perry Homes #7 in Best Construction & Trades Internships (2026), #18 for Best Internships for Women, and #45 for Overall Inclusion. Interns participate in professional development events, community engagement, and mentorship alongside their core department work.


## When Do Perry Homes Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Perry Homes posts its summer internships approximately 7–8 months before the start date, with track-specific application deadlines rather than a single closing date. The summer 2026 Legal Internship closed September 30, 2025, while the Purchasing Internship closed November 8, 2025, both for May–June 2026 starts.

### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Perry Homes uses hard application deadlines, not rolling review. The summer 2026 Legal Internship closed September 30, 2025, and the Purchasing track closed November 8, 2025. Once a deadline passes, no late applications are accepted regardless of qualifications. With a modestly-sized summer cohort at a private homebuilder, each track likely has only a handful of seats, making early preparation essential so you submit a polished application the day postings go live.

## Which Perry Homes Internship Programs Should You Target?


Perry Homes runs its summer internship as a single structured cohort with department-specific placements, offering at least six distinct tracks based on Vault reviews and documented job postings.


Track Focus Duration Key skills


Construction Management On-site oversight, phase inspections, OSHA logs, warranty tracking, developer meetings ~8–12 weeks Construction management, quality control, blueprint reading, OSHA compliance


Architecture / Design Home design support, floor plan review, material selection, design center coordination ~8–12 weeks AutoCAD/Revit, architectural drafting, residential design principles


Purchasing Vendor negotiations, rebate agreements, pricing/cost analysis, bid evaluation ~8–12 weeks Excel, cost analysis, vendor negotiation, supply chain


Legal Contract support, warranty/litigation research, real estate admin, special projects ~8–12 weeks Legal research, contract review, MS Office, attention to detail

Estimating (year-round) Cost analysis and data entry supporting the estimating department Part-time, ongoing Excel, data entry, cost estimation (separate from summer cohort)


Track availability varies by cycle. The Estimating Analyst Student Work role is a year-round part-time position separate from the structured summer program. See[Perry Homes Workable Portal](https://apply.workable.com/perryhomes/) for current openings.


## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Perry Homes sets a low experience bar but screens specifically for genuine interest in residential homebuilding.


• **Education:** High school diploma AND current enrollment in a university (bachelor's or higher)


• **Experience:** No prior experience required (stated explicitly on both Summer 2026 postings)


• **Work authorization:** US Citizen or Permanent Resident (Purchasing); US Citizen, Permanent Resident, or US Student Visa (Legal). International students are generally NOT eligible per Vault


• **Technical:** Working knowledge of MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)


• **Hours:** Full-time, at least 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday


### Does Perry Homes Have a GPA Cutoff for Interns?


No minimum GPA is published on any Perry Homes internship posting. The eligibility floor is simply current university enrollment and basic MS Office proficiency. This makes Perry Homes internships accessible to freshmen and sophomores. However, the company actively screens for genuine passion for residential construction during interviews. One Glassdoor report notes that a candidate who expressed preference for commercial construction was not advanced to the next round.

## What Is the Perry Homes Application and Interview Process Like?


Perry Homes uses a simple, fast hiring process with strong career fair recruiting in Texas.


1. **Visit the Workable portal** at apply.workable.com/perryhomes/ and filter by Internship category. Summer postings appear September through November.


2. **Submit your application online** through Workable. Perry Homes also recruits heavily at Texas university career fairs. One former intern reported being called the next day after a career fair.


3. **Round 1: Phone or virtual interview** with behavioral questions. Expect to be asked directly whether you want to work in residential construction specifically.


4. **Round 2: Interview with VP-level staff** such as the VP of Construction or department head. This is conversational and described as not difficult by former interns.


5. **Background check** (reported in approximately 50% of intern processes per Glassdoor) followed by offer.


The fastest path to an interview is attending a Texas career fair where Perry Homes recruits. Check with University of Houston and other Texas schools' career services for upcoming events.

## How Do You Stand Out at Perry Homes?


First, visit an active Perry Homes model home or community before your interview. Perry Homes operates 140+ communities across Texas and Florida, and referencing specific floor plans or design features shows genuine product knowledge that interviewers screen for. Second, lead with your passion for residential construction specifically. Glassdoor data confirms that candidates who expressed preference for commercial construction did not advance past interviews. Prepare a clear, authentic answer about why single-family homebuilding appeals to you. Third, attend a Texas university career fair where Perry Homes recruits. Vault reviews confirm the company called one candidate the next day after a career fair, bypassing the normal online queue entirely.

## FAQ


### When do Perry Homes internship applications open for summer 2027?


Based on the summer 2026 cycle, expect postings around September to November 2026 on Perry Homes' Workable portal. The Legal internship closed September 30, 2025, and Purchasing closed November 8, 2025, both roughly 7–8 months before start dates.


### What departments does Perry Homes offer internships in?


Perry Homes runs summer internships across construction management, architecture and design, marketing, video production, purchasing, and legal. A separate year-round part-time Estimating Analyst Student Work role also exists. Each department posts independently on the Workable portal.


### Do I need a specific major to intern at Perry Homes?


It depends on the track. Purchasing targets business, finance, or logistics majors. Legal targets legal studies. Construction favors engineering, construction management, or architecture. However, Perry Homes states no experience required and screens primarily for interest in residential homebuilding.


### What is the Perry Homes internship interview like?


Two rounds described as not difficult by former interns. The first is a phone or virtual behavioral interview. The second involves a VP-level manager. Perry Homes also recruits at Texas career fairs with very fast follow-up. Be ready to explain why residential construction interests you.


### Are Perry Homes internships paid?


Perry Homes does not publish a specific intern pay rate. Third-party estimates suggest modest compensation, but the methodology is unverified. The program emphasizes professional development, mentorship, networking, and community engagement as key benefits beyond base pay.


### Does Perry Homes sponsor international students for internships?


Generally no. Vault states international students are NOT eligible. The Purchasing track requires US Citizen or Permanent Resident status. The Legal track accepts US Student Visa holders. Eligibility varies by department, so check each posting for specific work-rights requirements.


### What is it like to intern at Perry Homes?


Former interns on Vault describe walking active construction sites with project managers, overseeing different phases of home construction, managing OSHA and inspection logs, and sitting in on meetings with developers, homeowners, and executives. Career development was called an exceptional part of the program.


### Does Perry Homes have a GPA requirement for interns?


No minimum GPA is published on any Perry Homes internship posting. Current university enrollment and working knowledge of MS Office are the stated requirements. The company screens for genuine interest in residential homebuilding rather than academic thresholds.
